description: This file defines the WebBridge class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace, implementing plugin interfaces for web communication via WebSocket, including internal state management, request handling, observer pattern, configuration, and interface methods for plugin lifecycle, message handling, and communication channels.

classes.name: WebBridge
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing WebSocket and plugin interfaces, managing state, observers, requests, and message routing.

classes.name: WebBridge::Config
classes.description: Configuration container for WebBridge with JSON serialization support, including timeout and bind address.

classes.name: WebBridge::Observer
classes.description: Represents a subscriber observer with ID and designator, supporting equality comparison.

classes.name: WebBridge::Request
classes.description: Encapsulates a request with channel ID, sequence ID, and timestamp for timeout handling.

classes.name: WebBridge::Cleaner
classes.description: A worker pool job class responsible for cleaning up resources by invoking WebBridge::Cleanup.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WebBridge plugin, attaching it to the service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the WebBridge plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns status or diagnostic information about the plugin.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Handles JSON-RPC messages for remote procedure calls.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin with the given service shell.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a communication channel (WebSocket) for this plugin.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Processes inbound messages, either by identifier or by ID and JSON element.

methods.name: HasMethodSupport
methods.description: Checks if a method is supported in a given version map.

methods.name: Destination
methods.description: Determines the destination state and handler based on the designator string.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Registers an observer for a specific event.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes an observer registration for a specific event.
